# Handoff Acknowledged

## Quick Assessment

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS | Delta |
|--------|----------|-----------|-------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 | -7.5% |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 | ⚠️ -88% |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** | ~0% |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** | +18.8% |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% | worse |

## Observations

1. **Champion holds**: Better tuning consistency and MDD profile
2. **Candidate trade-off**: Better lockbox minimum but significantly worse tuning minimum (0.05 is nearly flat) — suggests overfitting risk on certain folds
3. **Runloop healthy**: 13 iterations, ~22.5 hours remaining

## Recommended Actions

Execute the provided commands in sequence:
```bash
# 1. Run AUB autopilot for best candidate selection
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

# 2. Run system autopilot
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

# 3. Generate next fix report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Watch Items
- That tuning_min = 0.05 on the candidate warrants investigation — check which fold(s) are dragging
- Monitor if any new candidates improve lockbox_min without sacrificing tuning consistency
